narrative.northStar: A compact desktop control workspace with the real island
narrative.overview:
Near-black canvas, charcoal navigation, softly outlined graphite groups, and rounded Nunito text make a restrained native control workspace. Fine static dots identify the island preview and full-screen sizing canvas. The actual island supplies the live content; settings supplies clear controls and feedback.

This refresh supersedes the former purple atmosphere and wide navigation rail. It preserves the bundled regular and bold Nunito faces, matching native Windows titlebar, right-aligned controls, visible focus, and real island preview. Source authority is `crates/islet-settings/src/ui.rs`, `customize.rs`, `preview.rs`, and `main.rs`, with sizing behavior in core configuration, island layout, app window integration, and renderer. Measurements are egui logical points, expressed as px in portable tokens; they are not physical screenshot pixels. This record governs settings and the shipped widget extension; the island retains its independent visual language. Widget source authority is `crates/islet-render/src/widgets.rs`, `crates/islet-core/src/widgets.rs`, `crates/islet-core/src/island.rs`, and `crates/islet-app/src/island_window.rs`.
keyCharacteristics: Narrow navigation with authored line icons and restrained active rows.
Graphite groups, fine outlines, and a static dotted canvas.
Compact Nunito hierarchy with dedicated bold headings.
A native island preview and draft-only full-screen sizing.
Opt-in native tools with scroll-only page navigation and finite state changes.

rules.name: State Accent
rules.body: Reserve the cool accent for state and links; keep navigation and setting groups graphite.

rules.name: Utility Type
rules.body: Preserve the page-title, setting-label, description, and metadata hierarchy with real bundled bold faces for headings.

rules.name: Static Canvas
rules.body: Keep the dot grid still; animate interaction state rather than the workspace texture.

rules.name: Proportional Expansion
rules.body: Scale expanded content and its container together; preserve compact dimensions.

rules.name: Expanded-Only Widgets
rules.body: Show widget names, icons, and cards only in the expanded island. Enabling or selecting a widget must preserve compact activity and the configured Hidden or Sliver idle appearance; collapse remembers the selection for later expansion.

rules.name: Scroll Navigation
rules.body: Switch widget pages by scrolling over the settled expanded island. When another activity page is available, show two noninteractive dots stacked vertically at the right edge, centered on the current expanded card. The upper dot identifies the activity page and the lower dot Calculator. Keep Scroll text out of the island; do not add navigation arrows or make the dots clickable.

rules.name: Settled Widget
rules.body: Reuse the existing finite island morph and cross-fade for page changes; unchanged settled content snapshots must not trigger redraw. Calculator input and hover are event-driven and add no polling worker or background animation loop.

dos: **Do** pair setting labels and descriptions with right-aligned controls.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus and meaningful control metadata.
**Do** keep native caption controls and match their frame to the sidebar.
**Do** use the real island for preview and per-edge sizing feedback.
**Do** keep sizing edits as drafts until Apply changes.
**Do** preserve the readable calculator result and active-input tail across supported expanded scales.
**Do** keep dictation and urgent notices ahead of optional widget pages.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded purple atmosphere or wide sidebar.
**Don't** add independent width and height controls or resize the compact pill through expanded sizing.
**Don't** add widget navigation arrows or clickable page dots; scrolling is the page navigation mechanism.
**Don't** promote decorative kickers, glyph icons, or system display faces into shared components.
